title: Anchor tenant telemetry to request cohorts and add per-tenant graceful-retry circuit
creator: Avery Chen
description: Summary: After the 2025-02-07 customer escalation (INC-2025-02-07-HOSTED-5XX) we observed correlated 5xx waves caused by heterogeneous retry patterns across SDKs and large tenant cohorts. This ticket implements two coordinated changes: 1) anchor telemetry and SLO signals to request cohorts (by profile: short-sync, long-stream, embeddings-batch) so we can detect early cohort-level degradation with lower false positives, and 2) add a per-tenant graceful-retry circuit that transitions through OK -> Degraded -> GateClosed states based on cohort-anchored metrics. The goal is to reduce tenant-triggered amplified retries and provide safe fast-fail behavior without requiring full tenant quarantine.
progress_updates: 2025-02-14: Triage call with SRE/Platform/SDK teams. Agreed to anchor signals by request cohort rather than only tenant or global aggregates.
2025-02-18: PoC metric tags pushed to dev metrics pipeline (metrics-infra PR #1289). Initial cohorts: sync_small, sync_large, streaming, embed_batch.
2025-02-21: Load tests against canary cluster show 32% reduction in amplified retries when cohort gate enforces exponential backoff at Degraded state. Test run id: perf/2025-02-21-anchoring.
2025-02-25: Design review with PM and Security. Decided to keep per-tenant gate config as runtime feature flags to allow targeted rollouts to enterprise tenants.

2025-03-01: Implemented circuit FSM and graceful-fail path; added telemetry fields request.cohort, tenant.circuit_state, tenant.cooldown_window_ms. Integration tests passing locally. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hosted-runtime/pull/2321
acceptance_criteria: 1) Metrics pipeline emits cohort-tagged request latency, success_rate, and retry_count for all production routes. 2) Per-tenant circuit can be toggled via feature-flag and transitions OK->Degraded->GateClosed based on cohort thresholds. 3) When GateClosed, SDK receives 429/503 with transparent Retry-After and idempotency guidance. 4) No regressions in latency P95 for unaffected tenants. 5) Console dashboard shows cohort-level and tenant-circuit state trends. 6) Runbook updated with escalation/playbook entries.
implementation_notes: Anchoring approach: compute rolling windows on request.cohort (30s, 5m). Use decayed counters with reservoir sampling for latency distribution to avoid cardinality blowup.
Circuit thresholds: start with dynamic baseline (median+3*sigma) per-cohort derived during warm-up, with min absolute thresholds for safeguards.
Graceful-fail semantics: respond with structured error JSON including 'redwood_retry_hint' that SDKs can consume to adopt jittered exponential backoff; avoid opaque 5xx responses.
SDK coordination: added SDK-compatible error codes and advisory surface; SDK teams agreed to stop aggressive immediate retries for advisory codes in SDKs v1.12+.
Trade-offs considered: global tenant quarantine is simpler but noisy; per-tenant gate is more complex operationally but yields finer control and reduces collateral impact.
Performance: implemented lightweight in-memory sliding counters on edge-router to minimize added latency; added cold-shard mitigation to prevent spiky activation.
Data retention: cohort anchors stored for 30 days in metrics backend for regression detection; long-term retention in observability is configurable per release.
Rollback plan: feature-flag off for release, and an emergency kill-switch at frontdoor to revert to prior routing behavior if unexpected 5xx increase observed.
Open questions: exact window sizes for streaming cohorts; whether to include user-level priority hints from billing metadata in decisions.
reviews_and_feedback: PM (Samir Patel): asked for explicit customer opt-out for enterprise tenants until SDK rollout completes.
SRE (Maya Torres): requested additional tracing keys to correlate frontdoor->runtime->gpu-worker latency for cohort-heavy requests.
Design (Oliver Reed): suggested unobtrusive console indicators instead of forcing tenant-level UI alerts.
Security (Nadia Ibrahim): confirmed telemetry fields do not include PII and suggested KMS for circuit-control feature flags for large customers.
manual_steps_for_release: 1) Merge runtime PR and metrics PR to release branch.
2) Toggle feature-flag for 5% of tenants (non-enterprise) and monitor cohort-level SLOs for 48h.
3) Gradual ramp to 50% and then enterprise preview after SDK v1.12 rollout.
4) Update console with tenant-circuit health widget and link to runbook.
5) Notify support and customer success with template communication for affected customers.
postmortem_and_followups: Plan a retro after 2 weeks of canary: collect false-positive/negative counts for circuit transitions.
Instrument additional synthetic probes per cohort to detect correlated latency shifts earlier.
Follow-up ticket to add per-tenant cooldown tuning UI in Console (PM ticket to be created).
Evaluate TTL-based prefetched KV cache invalidation when tenant circuit enters Degraded to avoid stale large KV warmups.
